title: MySQL: gateways show as Binlog Dump in the processlist, not in SHOW REPLICAS

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: MySQL 8.4.13, six gateways and one

symptom: SHOW REPLICAS is empty with six gateways connected and with one. SHOW PROCESSLIST lists one Binlog Dump row per running gateway, with the gateway's address as host.
cause: Binlog dump clients show in the processlist.
effect: A check on SHOW REPLICAS reports no gateways.
fix: Check gateway connections in SHOW PROCESSLIST.
